goal: Replace legacy colour/geometry proposal authority with a lightweight rendered-pixel semantic operator gate that rejects known practice/range/static contacts before any scored fire.

observed: G0133 proved exact live shadow plumbing, zero profile input, and zero semantic authority.
G0133 accepted only 20 legacy proposal frames, confirmed two frames across ten fragmented track IDs, and visually included static or ambiguous geometry.
The archive contains rendered authority frames and target bounds for credited bot hits and known practice-target contacts.
Aligned authority crops are often partially occluded by the weapon sight, so official-hit association alone is not sufficient semantic training evidence.
hypotheses: A larger contextual rendered crop plus temporal residual motion can reject the known static/range components while retaining close and medium mobile bots.
More complete candidate-sequence logging can supply independent hard negatives and expose proposal fragmentation without hidden game state.
unknowns: Whether the existing proposal mask recalls enough real bots before ADS alignment.
Whether a compact CPU-only contextual classifier can separate bots from practice/static geometry at four-to-twelve-pixel component scale.
Whether the current two-bot build supplies enough close/medium rendered contacts in one bounded calibration.
falsifiers: Any known practice/static hard negative accepted with semantic authority.
Held-out performance that depends on duplicated frames from one encounter rather than independent games/sequences.
A refined live shadow confirmation whose selected crop does not visibly contain a bot.
Any profile input or shot during dataset or shadow calibration.

requirements.R1: Preserve the immutable G0031 champion, G0125 behavioural baseline, and default-off one-v-one profile without in-place mutation or promotion.
requirements.R2: Use only ordinary rendered RGB frames and visible UI in live operation; offline labels may use archived official outcomes and human/VLM crop review but never hidden live state.
requirements.R3: Preserve candidate source, frame sequence, target bounds, contextual crop, temporal lineage, label provenance, build and render profile for every dataset item.
requirements.R4: Keep proposal confidence, semantic confidence, motion confidence, tracking confidence and fire authority separate.
requirements.R5: A candidate model remains observer-only until all offline and live shadow gates pass; no threshold may be weakened to make a run pass.
requirements.R6: Prediction, coasting, minimap, optical flow, colour masks and compatibility proposals never independently authorize fire.
requirements.R7: Every live test is bounded, archived, input-clean and followed by exact browser/port cleanup verification.

acceptanceCriteria.C1: Dataset contains at least 50 independently receipted credited-bot rendered examples from at least 10 games and at least 12 independent practice/static hard-negative sequences including G0125 and G0133-family evidence.
acceptanceCriteria.C2: Held-out evaluation by game/sequence rejects 100 percent of known practice/static negatives and retains at least 80 percent of credited-bot examples whose rendered crop is semantically usable; optic-obscured or ambiguous samples are excluded with explicit reasons, not relabelled.
acceptanceCriteria.C3: All G0133 known/static replay candidates remain non-authoritative; warmup, HUD, optic, banner and damage-overlay fixtures remain rejected.
acceptanceCriteria.C4: Refined live shadow records zero profile input and zero shots, and every semantically accepted confirmation crop visibly contains a real bot.
acceptanceCriteria.C5: Refined live shadow obtains at least one track with five fresh semantic measurements, at least one bounded coasting/reacquisition event or an explicit no-event result, and no identity handoff to static geometry.
acceptanceCriteria.C6: A firing calibration is permitted only after C1-C5 and requires fresh same-track body-bounded alignment, one shot per authorization, immediate reassociation and zero non-bot contacts.
acceptanceCriteria.C7: Focused tests, full agent-player tests, canonical tests, profile/fallback/archive verification, model policy, skill regression, AKP adoption and cleanup all pass.

outOfScope: Promotion from a single refinement run.
Hidden author labels or world coordinates in live play.
Using an LLM or VLM as the frame-by-frame live input owner.
